item.description: Writer Ian Rankin takes us to the underbelly of uber wealthy London life in his new novel The Heights.

item.title: Rahm Emanuel maps out a vision for what Democrats can achieve after taking Congress
item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former congressman and Obama advisor Rahm Emanuel about what Democrats' strategy should be, now that they'll soon control both houses of Congress.

item.title: Democrats won big in the midterms, and President Trump is accepting the results
item.description: President Trump has spent the past 10 years claiming widespread fraud in American elections. And yet, as Republican losses continue to mount, Trump seems to be accepting it.

item.title: How religion helped Democrats win control of Congress
item.description: Several Democratic members of the clergy, as well as a Texas seminarian, James Talarico, won their races for the House and Senate on Tuesday. Here's how religion helped them connect with voters

item.title: How did data centers fare on Election Day?
item.description: Nearly 30 jurisdictions voted to reduce or stop data center growth on Tuesday. So what's next? We talk to a Wired reporter who's been covering AI.

item.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
item.description: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Navajo voters hop tractors, make extraordinary efforts to vote after widespread flooding
item.description: Four weeks of flooding washed out roads and sent thousands fleeing their homes on the Navajo Reservation. But many worked hard to get to polling places and voting day became part of the recovery process.

item.description: This election will determine control of Congress. Rep. Pete Aguilar, who represents California's 33rd Congressional District, shares how Democratic Party leaders are feeling as results come in.

item.title: Legendary photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
item.description: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.
